saw_lines: Nobody buys a scooter on specs alone. Buyers compare range, weight and battery swaps, then picture the daily route before they commit.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides whether the scooter fits their daily route.
Your 0 of 19 copy ads carry a proof number, so collect one real figure, like orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: 0 of 19 copy ads carry a proof number, so a new buyer has no count to trust before clicking. Collect one real figure, like orders shipped or reviews collected, and open the next batch with it on the creative.
6 of 19 copy ads open on the same “80 km” story, so buyers meet one line over and over. Test two angles against it, the 10 second battery swap and Find My tracking, with three variations each.
Only one CORE 2 video names a code, and your other ads give a new buyer no reason to act today. Put a first order offer in the opening line of three new ads, one per model.
16 ads have run 60+ days, so you have proven winners that already hold attention. Build three more variations of the oldest winner, from July, changing only the hook and the first image each time.
